newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo trades steady on mark, ignores franc.
newsitem.headline: Escudo trades steady on mark, ignores franc.

text.p: The escudo was trading quietly steady against the mark, ignoring movements in the French franc. Traders said the trend in the dollar would be the principal factor influencing trade in the Portuguese currency.
The escudo was trading at 101.05/07 against its 101.08/11 close on Friday.

The French franc weakened and then rallied against the German currency after Paris announced its budget deficit in 1997 was heading for 3.5-3.7 percent of gross domestic product (GDP). It says measures will be taken to cut the gap in 1997 to bring it closer to single currency targets.
